notes:
Even out no longer fades: each level change happens in the nearest pause with only a 5 ms click guard, so the level is simply right from that point on.
Reference shapes: CueLevel learns how much your approved references move between quieter and louder stretches (Measure reference shapes in References).
Good range: a band on the waveform shows where good material of this content type sits, and each cue is compared with it.
Even out now works as tightly as your good references, instead of a fixed 2 dB.
